svg.title: Coarse LogHilb²(P¹, D) and Hilb²(P¹) diagram
svg.desc: The local coarse logarithmic Hilbert space is a sky-blue disc on the left, containing the exceptional curve E in red, its A₁ singularity, two black boundary branches, and the discriminant Δ in green. A blow-down arrow leads to the affine chart U = A² with its discriminant parabola. Below, Hilb²(P¹) = P² is an unfilled disc containing incidence lines and a dotted sky-blue neighbourhood U centred at the double point V(u²). Here D = {∞}.
